## August at Café Mars

###### Starting August 30th, we say farewell to Sunday brunch and hello again to Sunday dinner! New dishes this month include a stuffed Jimmy Nardello peppers entree and a watermelon pudding for dessert! Come try them soon and keep an eye out for even more new dishes as we head into Autumn!

###### For more detailed updates, follow us [on IG: **@cafemarsbk**](https://www.instagram.com/cafemarsbk/?hl=en "@cafemarsbk") or join our mailing list.
